Hymn 123: Oh, May My Soul Commune with Thee
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: F Major
Composer: Lowell Mason
Lyricist/Text Author: Lon P. Clark
Category: Prayer and Supplication

This is hymn number 123 titled "Oh, May My Soul Commune with Thee" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in F Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Lowell Mason and the lyrics were written by Lon P. Clark.
